# visa-check: Procedure: departure

Detail for the skill's departure mode; the skill links here.

## Procedure: departure (the owner's employment ends)
Run the day after `employment_end` once `clock.py status --json` shows `"employment_end_confirmed": true`.
1. Note `employment_end` (E). Due dates, never by hand (the day counts are the route's reporting rules; confirm them
   against the card before use):
   `python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts'); import datetime as d, js_common as c; e = d.date.fromisoformat('<E>'); print('dso_report_by', e + d.timedelta(days=10)); print('employer_report_by', c.add_business_days(e, 5))"`
2. Four tickets with the workspace ticket tool (it picks the next free id and validates the schema), each with
   `--tier T3`, `--note "Information only, not legal advice."`, `--derived-from "<E> + <rule>; <knowledge page>; verified
   <run date>"`, and `--hard-deadline <date>` (`--due` where the date is soft): (a) report the end of employment to the
   DSO, in the SEVP Portal and by email (owner: the owner, `dso_report_by`); (b) confirm the employer reported the
   departure within the required business days (owner: the owner, `--type waiting`, `employer_report_by`); (c) ask the
   DSO whether the I-983 final evaluation is due and by when (owner: role legal-visa); (d) DSO or attorney: any
   pending extension filed on the departed employer's I-983 (owner: the owner, `--status needs-human`; a Q-id in
   `legal/questions.md`, or link the answer if an earlier ticket settled it).
3. The DSO email (the report plus the open questions), a draft and an approval request only. Re-read the DSO contact
   from the case checklist each time (`grep -n -i "dso" <checklist path>`; gone or changed: stop and ask), then
   `python3 scripts/outbox.py draft --channel email --kind official --to <DSO address> --subject "<subject>" --body-file <file>`
   and `python3 scripts/outbox.py batch --ids <O-id> --ticket <ticket a>`. Full name and student ID only.
4. Ledger: the open row in `## Unemployment ledger` starts at `unemployment.start`.
5. When the DSO answers in writing: record it in `legal/questions.md`, then
   `python3 scripts/clock.py set --visa-allowance-days N --allowance-source "<date, sender, subject>"`.
